prompt: The same audience watches the same total hours at the same bitrates, but a premiere concentrates viewing into a shorter busy period. Which budget changes most directly?

options.explanation: Wrong. Total watched time and bitrate are unchanged in this model.
Wrong. Viewing times do not themselves add another stored media copy.

options.text: Peak delivery capacity rises even if daily payload is unchanged
options.explanation: Correct. More simultaneous streams require more instantaneous bandwidth.

options.text: Daily viewers alone now determine peak bandwidth
options.explanation: Wrong. Concurrency and delivered bitrate still determine the busy-period load.

workedExample: Two viewing schedules can have equal daily viewer-hours but different peaks. The concentrated schedule stresses links and regional caches more intensely. Budget daily transfer cost and peak capacity separately, then add protocol overhead and failure margin.
